\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    xbar interval stacked,
    width=10cm,
    height=6cm,

    ytick={0,1,2.5,4,5},

    legend pos=north east

    \addplot coordinates {(2,0) (3,1) (4,2.5) (3,4) (0,5)};

  \end{axis}
